At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

Students in the last years of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar.

About the Role

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NhMAOg79R2M

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers — in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them.

Job Description: We are seeking a hands on, highly engaged Forward Deployed Engineer (Staff) specializing in Kubernetes, platform modernization, large scale stateful workload migration, and enterprise AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be embedded directly alongside enterprise client teams throughout the entire end to end lifecycle of an engagement. From initial architecture, bare metal/legacy re platforming, and AI cluster setup to live in the field troubleshooting and production rollout. This role sits directly within the Engineering Business Unit (BU), working side by side with product and core software teams. Unlike traditional professional services or post sales support roles, our Forward Deployed Engineering team operates as an extension of core engineering in the field. Our Core Mission: Reduce customer adoption friction, dramatically shorten software iteration cycles, and establish a high bandwidth, direct feedback loop between real world enterprise deployments and product development. Rapid Iteration & Friction Reduction: Identify recurring migration blockers and platform usability gaps in real world customer environments, rapidly building and testing field fixes to shorten feature iteration cycles from months to days. End to End Engagement Ownership: Stay actively embedded with customer technical teams from pre migration discovery through go live and operational stabilization, ensuring successful platform adoption and high customer trust. Hands on Field Implementation & Troubleshooting: Work shoulder to shoulder with client engineers in production environments to write code, build manifests, debug live networking/storage/GPU failures, and optimize VKS performance. Partner with product managers and core engineers to translate customer contributions into prioritized platform features. Bare Metal & Legacy Platform Migration: Lead technical migration strategies transitioning enterprise platforms, massive bare metal environments, and legacy data stacks over to VKS or cloud native Kubernetes targets. THE ROLE:

As the leader of the Programmable Clock Design & Methodologies team in India for AMD's Adaptive-Embedded Computing products, you will be responsible for driving the development of clocking solutions that meet the high standards of AMD's AECG products. This will involve leading a team of highly skilled engineers in India, as well as collaborating with the global Clock team of experts at the San Jose office, inventing and implementing original solutions, addressing challenging clock problems in some of the industry’s largest and most complex SOCs.

Every new Adaptive SOC brings a new set of programable Clock challenges with their latest system and functional architectures and their adoption of new semiconductor and packaging technologies. The Global Clock team works closely with functional Architecture, Programable fabric, Integration and SW teams to craft and implement new clock solutions, including new architectures, Clock IPs and development of new tools, flows & Methodology.

This can be a challenging but exciting opportunity.

THE PERSON:

This is a critical role within the company, and requires a combination of technical expertise, leadership skills, and effective communication. If you are passionate about clocking methodologies and have a track record of leading successful teams, this could be an exciting opportunity for you to join a innovative programmable Clock team at AMD.

You will lead by bringing people together and drive towards consensus, decisions, and results. Working independently, you will convert high level concepts down to tangible specifications that can be implemented efficiently. You should enjoy collaborating with engineers with their diverse skillsets and bring their expertise to bear on solving challenging Programable Clock problems.

• Developing Programable global Clock distribution methodologies, optimizing Clock - Skew, Signal integrity and power integrity issues for AMD's next generation of programmable product families.
• Large Scale Block to Block Clock timing analysis, within the Die & Die to Die Clock interposer crossing.

• Deep analysis of timing paths to identify and debug key issues.

• Collaborate with functional IP teams (RTL, Ckt, physical design, Full Chip Timing, Integration) during the implementation and qualification of a growing number of programable Clock IPs.

jobs.description: ABOUT VOODOO Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become. You will be part of the team building Castle Busters, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that. Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will: - Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server. - Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted. - Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions. 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

개발자 플랫폼(Developer Platform) 팀은 수천 개의 마이크로서비스 규모로 확장되는 쿠팡의 내부 워크로드 관리 및 마이크로서비스 생태계를 포함하여, 쿠팡의 개발자 경험을 책임지고 있습니다. 현재 최신 기술을 도입하여 개발자 경험과 내부 인프라를 혁신하는 과정을 거치고 있습니다.

분산 시스템에 대한 깊은 이해와 대규모 백엔드 서비스, Kubernetes, gRPC 및 Service Mesh에 대한 실무 경험을 갖춘 아키텍트를 모십니다. 귀하는 쿠팡의 모든 내부 서비스를 지탱하는 최신 플랫폼을 설계하고, 이를 구현할 팀을 이끄는 역할을 담당하게 됩니다.

업무 내용

• 워크로드 및 서비스 관리 인프라 설계
• 핵심 인프라 구성 요소를 직접 개발(Hands-on)
• 복잡한 문제를 단순하고 명확한 솔루션으로 분해하며, 팀이 과감하게 우선순위를 정하고 "신속하게 움직일 수 있는(move with urgency)" 메커니즘 제공
• 최고 수준의 아키텍처와 설계를 갖춘 확장 가능한 시스템 및 서비스 구축
• 심각한 시스템 문제를 깊이 있게 분석(Dive deep)하고, 유사한 근본 원인을 선제적으로 해결하여 운영 우수성 수준 향상
• 쿠팡의 다른 테크 리더들과 협력하여 혁신의 기회를 창출할 수 있도록 서비스의 확장성 확보

자격 요건

• 컴퓨터 공학 또는 관련 기술 분야의 학사 학위를 소지하신 분
• 최근 3년 이내 대규모 분산 시스템 설계 및 개발 실무 경험이 있으신 분
• Golang, C/C++, Python, Java 중 하나 이상에 능숙하신 분
• 미션 크리티컬(Mission Critical) 시스템을 성공적으로 수행한 경험이 있으신 분
• AWS, Azure, GCP 등 클라우드 컴퓨팅 사용 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

• Kubernetes, Go 언어 및 AWS 클라우드 경험이 있으신 분
• JSON, YAML, Jsonnet 및 gRPC 경험이 있으신 분
• 운영체제(OS) 커널 및 Kafka, Cassandra, Google Spanner와 같은 분산 시스템에 대한 깊은 이해가 있으신 분
• 동시성(Concurrency), 멀티스레딩(Multi-threading), 동기화(Synchronization) 및 Non-blocking IO 경험이 있으신 분
• 빠르게 변하는 환경에서 다수의 상충하는 우선순위를 관리하고, 복잡한 비즈니스 제공을 위한 대규모 서비스 릴리스를 리드할 수 있는 능력
• 영어로 유창하거나 원활한 소통이 가능하신 분
• 컴퓨터 공학 또는 기타 관련 기술 분야의 석사 또는 박사 학위를 소지하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형 절차 서류전형 - 1차 면접 - 2차 면접 - 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
• 참고 사항 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
• 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

Company Introduction
We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.
As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large-scale, cross-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business-critical outcomes.
This role requires a unique combination of technical depth, organizational leadership, operational rigor, and strategic thinking. You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.
The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.
What You Will Do
Lead strategic, organization-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
Drive end-to-end program ownership from vision, planning, and roadmap development through execution and operationalization.
Partner with engineering leaders and principal engineers to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of critical initiatives.
Drive large-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.
Lead initiatives involving infrastructure scalability, cloud adoption, capacity planning, service availability, and operational readiness.
Analyze complex technical and business data to drive prioritization, decision-making, and resource allocation.
Define and track organizational KPIs, operational health metrics, reliability goals, and business outcomes.
Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
Drive executive-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Establish and continuously improve operational excellence practices across engineering teams.
Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.
Basic Qualifications
12+ years of experience leading large-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
Proven experience driving organization-level initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
Experience managing highly complex cross-functional programs with significant technical and business impact.
Demonstrated ability to define strategy and translate ambiguous business objectives into executable plans.
Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
Experience identifying root causes, managing risks, and solving complex organizational and technical challenges.
Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.
Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across organizations without direct authority.
Demonstrated leadership in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, or large-scale distributed systems environments.
Strong technical understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, cloud-native architectures, and infrastructure automation.
Experience managing cloud infrastructure programs involving compute, networking, storage, observability, security, or AI/ML platforms.
Experience driving reliability, availability, scalability, and operational excellence initiatives for mission-critical services.
Familiarity with capacity planning, infrastructure lifecycle management, and cloud business operations.
Experience partnering with Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders to drive architecture and platform transformation initiatives.
Experience defining and implementing executive operating mechanisms and organizational governance models.
MBA or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience operating within hyper-growth technology organizations.
Experience building and mentoring high-performing TPM teams.
Why This Role Matters
As a Senior Staff TPM in CIC, you will directly influence the future of Coupang's cloud platform. You will help define how infrastructure, platform services, AI capabilities, and operational excellence scale to support the company's next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with significant impact across engineering and business organizations, offering the opportunity to shape the strategy and execution of one of the most critical technology platforms within Coupang.

jobs.description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Client Services Associate Project Manager – Packaging Monday – Friday 8:30am – 5pm Take the next step in your project management career and help deliver clinical studies that make a difference. We are looking for an organised, proactive and customer-focused Associate Project Manager (APM) to join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience in project support, coordination or a related environment who is ready to take on greater ownership. You will work alongside experienced Project Managers while also taking responsibility for your own projects, coordinating activities across multiple teams from study set-up through to completion. Working in a fast-paced clinical supply environment, you will be at the centre of bringing together customers, internal teams, production schedules, documentation and key milestones to ensure studies are delivered successfully. What will you do? As an Associate Project Manager, you will help keep clinical studies moving by ensuring the right people, products and services come together at the right time. You will build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, proactively communicating progress, identifying priorities and helping resolve issues before they impact delivery. Your responsibilities will include: Managing projects from set-up through to completion, coordinating technical, operational and service activities across the business. Partnering with customers and internal teams to understand study requirements and provide clear, timely updates. Planning and tracking key milestones, timelines, critical-path activities and responsibilities using appropriate project management tools and processes. Coordinating study readiness, ensuring the required services, products, documentation and information are in place when needed. Supporting clinical supply planning, working closely with the Master Production Scheduler to balance customer requirements with available production capacity.
